ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent freeze of Medicaid funds in Minnesota and the suspected fraud behind it.
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to uncover the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How much money has been lost to fraudulent activities?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable.
